title: Federal Register: Submission for OMB Review; Commercial Acquisitions (OMB Control No. 9000-0136)

history.reason: Source read directly (PDF from GovInfo converted to text) on the access date; findings transcribed from the document.

publisher: DoD, GSA and NASA (via GovInfo / Federal Register)
source_type: Government Paperwork Reduction Act notice (offeror representations and certifications, commercial acquisitions)
reliability: Government document; the issuing agencies (DoD, GSA, NASA) also administer the registration and certification requirements they estimate. Burden figures are agency estimates, not measurements.
findings: The collection covers FAR 52.212-3, Offeror Representations and Certifications for commercial products and services; paragraph (b)(2) requires offerors to identify which of paragraphs (c) through (v) they completed for the relevant solicitation only.
The notice states changes under paragraph (b)(2) apply to that solicitation only and do not update the representations and certifications posted in SAM.
Annual burden: 140,055 respondents, 414,909 total annual responses, 207,455 total burden hours (about 0.5 hours per response by our arithmetic).
Three comments received on the 60-day notice (90 FR 14450, April 2, 2025) were supportive and did not change the estimate.
limitations: Covers only the solicitation-specific selection step for commercial acquisitions, not completing the annual representations and certifications in SAM itself.
Agency estimate with no method and no breakdown by business size.
Other FAR provisions that require representations (for example small business status) sit under other control numbers that were not read.
